topic: POV gap: retail buyer won't set the item because one certificate lists five products; 16 CFR 1110.13(a) one product per certificate
vo: One certificate for all your SKUs? Your buyer may say no.
My buyer won't set the item. One certificate, five products.
The rule: each certificate must describe only one product.
So I split it: one certificate per product.

caption:
One certificate covering your whole product line? That's a gap.
16 CFR 1110.13(a) says a finished product certificate must accompany each product or shipment that has to be certified, and each certificate must describe only one product.
Say a seller sends a buyer one PDF listing five SKUs. Splitting it into one certificate per product is the fix.

sources.claim: A certificate must accompany each product or shipment; each certificate must describe only one product
sources.quote: A finished product certificate must accompany each finished product or finished product shipment required to be certified pursuant to § 1110.5. Each finished product certificate must describe only one product.
